title: Customer Standing Terms: Booking Reliability Reduction on the Rental Vehicle Coordination Young-Renter Charge
content:
**Standing term.** The reliability reduction on the young-renter charge of a Rental Vehicle Coordination rental follows the customer's estimate bookings with the network under Repair Estimates & Appointments: a customer with a booking converted into a repair and no booking ever marked no-show takes 20 percent; a customer with a converted booking and a no-show on record takes 10 percent; any other customer takes zero. The young-renter charge is reduced by that percent: it is multiplied by one hundred less the reduction and divided by one hundred.

## Records read

The statuses of every estimate booking the customer has held under Repair Estimates & Appointments: whether any booking stands as converted into a repair, and whether any booking was ever marked no-show.

## Reduction table

| Booking converted into a repair | Booking marked no-show | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | 20 percent |
| Yes | Yes | 10 percent |
| No | Yes | 0 |
| No | No | 0 |

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer whose drive-in estimate booking was converted into a repair, with no no-show ever: a young-renter charge of 125.00 USD before the reduction becomes 100.00 USD.
- The same customer with an earlier photo estimate booking marked no-show: the reduction is 10 percent, and the 125.00 USD becomes 112.50 USD.
- A customer whose only booking was marked no-show and never converted: no reduction.
